extension.documentation: Group granted access to the BlobDiff documents, in addition to "administrators". Being prefixed with org.nuxeo.web.ui, it is also exposed to Web UI as Nuxeo.UI.config.blobaudit.auditorsGroup, which drives the visibility of the drawer entry and of the document tab. Override this property rather than config/auditorsGroup, so that the server and the UI stay in sync.
